decisions: Service, treatment and condition HUB cards use the locked designed badges (style guide). The photos here are the LEAD image on each detail page, beside the answer-first intro.
Every image is displayed at or below its source width. Never upscale. Max display px is the source width.
Lab, equipment and X-ray images carry the caption "Illustrative image" so they do not imply EVE's own facilities.
No image is shown as a patient or as a result. Patient-story images and baby imagery are on hold.
The doctor portrait name tag was corrected from "Dr. Swati Sharma" (her earlier name) to "Dr. Swati Shree". The original is kept in _originals-as-received.

Items with no usable photo get a designed badge panel: Egg freezing, Endometrial biopsy, Female factor infertility, Fibroids, Adenomyosis, Thin endometrium and low ovarian reserve, Thyroid and fertility, Coming from outside Bangalore, legal pages.
The only image preloaded is the hero portrait, and it is interim.

hold.why: Newborn imagery implies a result, and the locked hero is one doctor on one portrait card.
Shows whole eggs in jars. Medically misleading for egg freezing. Replace.
Carries a Science Photo Library watermark. Copyright risk.
Pointed metal instruments look like dental tools and frighten patients. Replace.
Dark, shows a fetal-looking scan and nonsense screen text. A better follicular image is in services/.
Staff member at a pink desk. Does not show endometriosis. Pink is stronger than the blush.
Patient-story card image. Patient stories are removed (testimonials not allowed).
Baby booties under a patient-story name implies an outcome.
Nursery mobile under the name "Success" implies an outcome.
Google Maps screenshot with a stranger's username.
307x472 is too small. A printed hours sign is partly visible but cut off.
